name: Fantasy Arcana: A Date With Destiny
source:
You all meet in a tavern… and everything goes off the rails. Cue the magic, mayhem, and more mischief than you bargained for.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你们在一家酒馆里相遇……随后一切彻底脱轨失控。魔法、骚乱，还有远超你预料的恶作剧就此轮番登场。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
